0.0: It all started a few weeks ago, when I noticed father holding on to that awful wallet of his... It made me so mad. It doesn't even have a place for a picture of me!
0.1: Anyway, I tried to take it away from him and throw it in the fire, like I did with the last six wallets, but he got this insane look in his eye.
0.2: It was the same look that AWFUL #bGigatoad#k gave me when I tried to burn HIS wallet. I put Nobuo, Fuji, and that adorable little bird of his on the case right away.
0.3: I'm assuming Fujihawk gave you a good rundown of his plan? It's shockingly well-thought-out, and the presentation was just lovely. If you have all of the items, I'm certain you can release this CRUMBLING MESS we call a castle from the grips of the evil #bGigatoad#k.

yes.0: #bGigatoad#k has taken over father's chambers at the very top of the tower. Even if he looks like father, I want you to beat his UGLY pants off.
yes.1: Oh, and bring me that #bwallet#k. It has a date with the fireplace.

no.0: Do I need to tell you everything again? Were you distracted by how crooked this STUPID umbrella is?

1.0: You're back! Are you hurt? Where's the wallet?
1.1: This is... The #t04000346#? Ugh, I get so mad just LOOKING at it! But that means the Toad is gone, right?!
1.2: (Fujihawk swoops by in a majestic arc, dropping a letter into #p9110106#'s hand. His parting cry may just be the most beautiful farewell you've ever heard.)
1.3: This letter is from #p9110108#. It says... Fujihawk found my father! In a prison cell... Why didn't we look there first?
1.4: It really would have saved a lot of time if... OW, PAPERCUT! I HATE this letter!\r\n(She crumples the letter and throws it violently into a bush.)
1.5: This whole ordeal has taught me a lesson... But I don't really know what it was. Can I just pay you so that we don't have to think about it any more?\r\n(She hands you the #t04000346#, which is filled to the brim with money!)

item.0: I don't think #bGigatoad#k has been sufficiently punished. Bring me back that accursed #bmoney#k he made off of the poison seller.
